name: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5060 (reference specifications)
description: Documented hardware identity, not a currently purchasable offering or measured runtime tuple. Research snapshot; no serving or training-fit claim. precisions list the v1 enum values supported on Blackwell; int4 is omitted (CUDA Table 33 INT4 cell blank for compute capability 12.x); FP4/FP6 are native Blackwell formats with no v1 enum value, so their absence is not a claim they are unsupported.

provenance.notes: Source: Router's primary-source check blackwell-vram-variants-2026-10-18.md (Router re-read the row on nvidia.com 2026-10-18; first pass by SCOUT hermies_advisor_35b session 83ee44f5); not re-fetched by the author. GeForce RTX 5060: 8 GB GDDR7, 128-bit bus (bus width recorded here: schema has no bus-width field), 145 W. GeForce power is Total Graphics Power for the Founders/reference design; AIB cards vary. Verbatim rows read by Router on the RTX 5060 family page 2026-10-18: "Standard Memory Config | 16 GB / 8 GB GDDR7 | 8 GB GDDR7" (5060 Ti | 5060), "Memory Interface Width | 128-bit | 128-bit", "Total Graphics Power (W) | 180 | 145".
